title: planner · Plan to identify 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static agent memory u
summary: Plan to identify 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static agent memory under fixed token budgets, targeting LongMemEval and similar benchmarks.
body:
1. Search for papers/reports comparing dynamic memory consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) under strict token limits, measuring task success/hallucination. Limit to 4 sources.
2. Inspect each source for controlled experiments matching token budgets, not just theoretical claims. Extract metrics: task success rate, hallucination rate, token usage.
3. Validate if sources provide a direct, budget-comparable comparison. If a source lacks controlled token constraints or baseline comparison, mark as 'unverified' and exclude from final evidence set.
4. If 4 sources are exhausted without meeting criteria, stop and document the evidence gap per Phase 1 rules. Do not implement code.
